note: The usual member of a parent whose rows do not agree (docs/ingredient-catalogue.md#usual-member). A dish line that names the parent ("egg", "butter", "milk": the source names no kind) is counted with the figures of this member where the parent has none of its own. Every choice is a judgement of the project, made on 2026-11-21 and stated in `why`; no number is written here: the generator reads the member's numbers from the dataset. Only parents that a shipped dish line points at with an amount are listed.

groups.why: a recipe's egg is a fresh hen's egg in its shell; the other rows are dried egg powders
the yolk of a fresh egg; the other row is dried yolk
the white of a fresh egg; the other rows are dried whites
butter without salt: the sources season with salt on its own line; the rows differ in sodium, whipped and light butter are other products
whole cow's milk, without added vitamins: the plain milk of the sources; the other rows are skimmed, dried, evaporated, flavoured or of other animals
white granulated sugar; powdered and maple sugar are named as such where a source wants them
light whipping cream (about 31 % fat), the row nearest to the cream a European source means; sour cream and half and half are other products
as for Cream: light whipping cream, about 31 % fat
ordinary grated parmesan; the other row is a low-sodium product
white all-purpose flour without enrichment: the plain flour of the sources; whole-grain, bread and tortilla-mix flour are other products
as for Wheat flour: white all-purpose flour without enrichment
olive oil, the oil of the Spanish, French and Italian sources; almost every oil row has the same energy and fat
red wine vinegar, the vinegar of European cookery; distilled and cider vinegar differ little, balsamic is named as such
the dataset's own row for apples with skin that names no variety
cos or romaine, the head lettuce of the shipped Spanish dish; the leaf lettuces are close in figures but lighter per head
white button mushroom, the cultivated mushroom; chanterelle, morel and enoki are named as such
green sweet pepper, the pepper of the shipped gazpacho; red differs mainly in sugar
fresh green peas; split dried peas and sprouted peas are other products
white medium-grain rice, the rice the catalogue already gives the risotto; brown rice is named as such
as for Rice: white medium-grain rice
